rules.title: Community rules
rules.intro: A few rules to keep the Community a good place to share and study.
rules.respectBody: No insults, threats, harassment or hate speech based on race, gender, orientation, religion, disability or anything else.
rules.contentBody: No violent or sexually explicit content, anything illegal, or material that promotes self-harm.
rules.spamBody: No repetitive posts, misleading links, unrelated promotions or chain messages.
rules.relevanceBody: Flashcards, posts and comments should be relevant to studying. Off-topic or useless material can be reported.
rules.plagiarismBody: Do not share copyrighted material without permission, or pass someone else's work off as your own.
rules.accuracyBody: Avoid spreading misinformation, especially in flashcards and study material presented as fact.
rules.privacyBody: Do not share personal data about yourself or others (phone numbers, addresses, private photos) without consent.
rules.fraudBody: No fake accounts, impersonation of other people, or phishing/scam attempts.
rules.manipulationBody: No bots, fake votes or other means of artificially inflating a post's visibility or popularity.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This page explains what data Flashcards Manager collects, why, and how you can control it.

who.title: Who processes your data
who.body: Flashcards Manager is a personal project built and run by a student, not a company. For any question or request about your data, you can write through the contact at the bottom of this page.

dataCollected.title: What data I collect
dataCollected.intro: When you create an account, I collect:
dataCollected.password: your password, never stored in plain text: I only keep its hash
dataCollected.email: your email address (optional): only used to confirm your account and to post in the Community
dataCollected.ip: At registration, I also record your IP address, only to prevent creating new accounts after a ban: it is never shown to anyone and used for nothing else.
dataCollected.content: Besides account data, I keep what you create using the service: your flashcards, subjects and topics, and the posts and reports you make in the Community.

why.title: Why I use it
why.body: I use this data solely to run your account and login, send you the confirmation email, show your flashcards and your public content in the Community, and enforce the community rules when a report comes in.

sharing.title: Who I share it with
sharing.body: I do not sell or hand over your data to anyone. Only two technical services receive it to help me manage the platform: the provider that delivers the confirmation email (it only receives the address and the email content) and, if enabled, a private Telegram bot that notifies me when a report is filed in the Community (it receives the reported content, never your password).

storage.title: Where it's stored
storage.body: Data is stored in the database of the server hosting the site.

retention.title: How long I keep it
retention.body: Account data is kept for as long as the account exists. The IP address recorded at signup is deleted automatically after a few hours. You can ask for your account to be fully deleted at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask at any time to see, correct or delete your data, by writing through the contact below.

localStorage.title: Cookies and browser storage
localStorage.body: The site does not use tracking or advertising cookies. It only uses your browser's local storage to keep you signed in and remember your preferences (light/dark theme, language): this data stays on your device and is never sent to anyone.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: This page may be updated in the future; the date at the top shows the last change.
